authority: AI-Assisted Software Engineering Governance Standard v1.0; owner-approved FAT roadmap; RP-02 v0.6 Choice A
assurance: source-first synthetic candidate. Independent CP-02 and Bodhi7 FAT remain OPEN.
protected: fixed O1 argv and device allowlist
operator consent and root-helper wire protocol
proof_rules: Direct SRC-18/21 combined-byte overflow: positive original omission, both streams nonempty and individually below same approved per-target cap; preserved sum exactly equals cap, both complete originals sealed; no timeout or writer clip.

SRC-13 helper byte overflow: only if preserved aggregate reaches full approved 8 MiB per-request cap; this proves the helper did NOT internally lower its applied threshold, despite possible cumulative constraints. Cannot infer any shorter cap.
All limit witnesses must bind original same-run D0 inventory, approved fixed argv and current operator consent and match in-memory execution witness.
Timeout and byte overflow, writer and transport clipping, zero-omission boundary, arbitrary or tied stream/combined dimensions must not be labeled as a unique fact.
Never change installed helper or privilege protocol to expose internal cumulative remaining quotas.

cases.given: SRC-18 direct combined overflow 4MiB with stdout+stderr each below cap; positive omitted stderr
cases.expect: one exact transport byte witness and canonical PASS

cases.given: SRC-21 direct combined overflow 8MiB with both streams below cap
cases.expect: one exact transport witness and canonical PASS

cases.given: SRC-13 helper returned full 8MiB original and positive omission
cases.expect: helper applied cap necessarily 8MiB; transport witness PASS

cases.given: SRC-13 helper returned only 100B with exceeded_limit (possible internal cumulative remainder)
cases.expect: no claimed threshold; canonical fail closed

cases.given: direct O1 retained only stdout exactly equal to combined cap
cases.expect: both stream and combined dimensions tied; no claimed dominant dimension

cases.given: transport overflow at less than full registered cap, timed-out simultaneously, or writer clipping
cases.expect: no exact independent transport witness; canonical fail

cases.given: missing original D0 inventory; forged v0.6 transport scope/threshold/extent

cases.expect: exact candidate head CI SUCCESS, not CP-02 acceptance

deferred: Ambiguous direct stdout/stderr tied with combined ceiling
SRC-13 helper internally reduced byte cap <8MiB and any internally reduced deadline
O1 timeouts and independent source-total/time/call count events
real device validation and owner FAT acceptance
